b16450468.desc: Discover a huge and spacious 2-bedroom residential apartment in the vibrant Dubai Marina, offering a luxurious lifestyle in one of the city’s most desirable locations. This impressive unit in the Lootah Complex (Al Husn Marina) is now available for rent, presenting an exceptional opportunity for those looking to immerse themselves in the allure of marina living. The apartment features a well-thought-out layout, providing ample space for relaxation and entertaining. With two bathrooms, it ensures comfort and privacy for you and your guests. The contemporary design combined with generous living areas makes it an ideal choice for individuals or families seeking a modern home that caters to their needs. Living in Dubai Marina means embracing a lifestyle filled with leisure and convenience. The community is renowned for its stunning waterfront views, bustling promenade, and an array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Enjoy the proximity to pristine beaches, luxury yachts, and vibrant nightlife, all within walking distance. The area is well-connected, making it easy to access major roadways and public transport links, ensuring you are never far from the best that Dubai has to offer. The Lootah Complex (Al Husn Marina) is designed to enhance your living experience, surrounded by a thriving community atmosphere that attracts both residents and visitors alike. Whether you prefer a leisurely stroll along the marina or indulging in the culinary delights of nearby restaurants, this location caters to every lifestyle. Don’t miss your chance to make this spacious apartment your new home. Contact us today to arrange a viewing or to request more information about this remarkable opportunity in Dubai Marina. Experience the luxury and convenience that awaits you in this exceptional property.
